title: Grateful Dead Live at Texas Christian University on 1971-11-14

ai_review.summary: Highly praised performance hailed as a top‑five Dead show; recording quality is unspecified but appears satisfactory.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers celebrate this concert as an outstanding example of the early ’70s Dead, with one even calling it among the top five shows ever. No specific technical comments were made, suggesting the sound is at least listenable, while the musical energy is described as great throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are positive (4‑ and 5‑star) and emphasize a high‑energy, memorable performance; lack of recording details keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not mention any sound issues or source type, implying the audio is acceptable for listening.
